_comment: Framework-detection evals for Step 2 of the auth0 router. Each case lists the backticked project signals present (verbatim from SKILL.md's detection tables) plus an optional api_intent, and asserts the framework the 'stop at first match' cascade must resolve to. These lock down the ordering traps: Ionic/Capacitor rows must beat plain framework rows, @auth0/nextjs-auth0 must beat @auth0/auth0-react, expo must beat react-native, and the php/laravel/express/aspnetcore web-vs-API variant split. Run with scripts/check_framework_detection.py. OUT OF SCOPE (see the checker's module docstring): Tier 3 prompt-only detection and prose-only Tier 2 distinctions (*.csproj MAUI/WinForms/WPF/ASP.NET flavor, 'HTTP server/router'), which carry no backticked signal to model mechanically.

cases._why: @auth0/nextjs-auth0 row precedes @auth0/auth0-react; a Next.js app also has react in deps, but the SDK row must win.
Ionic project also carries @auth0/auth0-angular; the @capacitor/browser row must be checked first.
No Next.js / Ionic markers -> the plain @auth0/auth0-react row.
react-native-auth0 + app.json present -> expo, not react-native.
react-native-auth0 with NO Expo files -> react-native (negated app.json/app.config.js).
Distinct SDK packages; the -api SDK must resolve to fastify-api.
auth0/auth0-php + STRATEGY_API -> php-api; the STRATEGY_API row precedes the plain php row.
auth0/login + AuthorizationGuard -> laravel-api; must beat the plain auth0/login laravel row above it (which negates AuthorizationGuard).
auth0/login with NO AuthorizationGuard -> laravel.
Auth0.AspNetCore.Authentication.Api is a superstring of the auth row token; exact-token matching + row order must land on aspnetcore-api.
No Auth0 SDK; Tier 2 detects nextjs from `next` in package.json.
Tier 2 Ionic ordering: @ionic/* + vue must beat the plain vue row.
Tier 2 express base, no API intent -> express web variant.
Tier 2 express base WITH api_intent -> express-jwt via variant disambiguation.
laravel/framework base + api_intent -> laravel-api.
@auth0/auth0-nuxt is distinct from @auth0/nextjs-auth0; must resolve to nuxt, not nextjs.
@auth0/auth0-fastify (no -api suffix) -> fastify web, distinct from the fastify-api row.
Auth0.AspNetCore.Authentication (no .Api suffix) -> aspnetcore-auth; the negated `.Api` token must NOT be present. Guards the pair with tier1-aspnetcore-api-suffix.
auth0/auth0-php with NO STRATEGY_API signal -> php web; the php-api row above requires STRATEGY_API, so the negated php row must fire.
Package.swift satisfies the swift OR-group (`Package.swift` or `.xcodeproj`).
pubspec.yaml + auth0_flutter WITHOUT `flutter.web: false` -> flutter-web; the flutter-native row above requires that token, so this falls through to flutter-web.
